Package comp3607.group10.telemetry

Class TelemetryService

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.TelemetryService
public class TelemetryService extends Object
Creates every part of the extension and connects them. It starts the background worker, recovers a backup left by a crash, and handles manual export and shutdown. BlueJ code talks to this class only.
Author:
Reinaldo Singh

  • Constructor Details

    • TelemetryService

      public TelemetryService(Path outputDirectory, String studentIdSeed, Clock clock, ZoneId zone, long backupIntervalMillis)
      Creates the service with every dependency given, which lets the tests control time and folders.
      Parameters:
      outputDirectory - the folder for the backup, and for reports when no project folder is known
      studentIdSeed - the value the anonymous student ID is made from
      clock - gives the current time
      zone - the time zone used for readable times and file names
      backupIntervalMillis - how often to back up, in milliseconds

    • TelemetryService

    • shutdown

      public boolean shutdown(long timeout, TimeUnit unit, ReportsWrittenListener onExported)
      Ends the session, writes the final reports and stops the worker thread.
      Parameters:
      timeout - the longest time to wait
      unit - the unit of the timeout
      onExported - told which files were written
      Returns:
      true if everything finished before the timeout
